EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS


BETWEEN

Claimant:

Mr Abjol Hussain

AND

Sainsbury's Supermarkets Ltd


JUDGMENT OF THE EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNAL


Heard at:

London South (Croydon)
(by video link)

On: 20 and 21 November 2025
Case number:

Before:
6019164/2024

Employment Judge M Da Costa




APPEARANCES:

Claimant:
In person via video link - unrepresented
Respondent:
Mr Amitpal Bachu of counsel for the respondent





Case number 6019164/2024
2


JUDGMENT
The judgment of the Tribunal is as follows:
Complaint of unfair dismissal pursuant to section 111(1) Employment
Rights Act 1996 contrary to section 94 of that Act

1. The claimant's claim for unfair dismissal is not well founded and is dismissed.
2. The respondent had a potentially fair reason to dismiss the claimant within section
98(2)(b) of the Act.
3. The respondent acted fairly in dismissing for that reason because the respondent
acted reasonably in treating the reason as a sufficient reason for dismissing the
claimant within the meaning of section 98(4) of that Act.




M Da Costa

Employment Judge M Da Costa
28 November 2025
